data.title: Multichromatic porous silicon RGB rugate filters for use in smartphone biosensing
data.author: Zachary D. Martin, Sharon M. Weiss
data.summary: In this work, we report a porous silicon-based multichromatic rugate filter to select red (R), green (G), and blue (B) wavelengths from white light illumination provided by a smartphone. The full width at half-maximum values for all three color bands are below 30 nm. Spectral characterization was carried out with a spectrometer, and chromatic analysis was applied to smartphone images of the filter to verify the desired performance. Conversion of white light from the LED flash of a smartphone to multichromatic RGB illumination can be used in smartphone-based biosensing for improved limit of detection.
data.title_cn: 用于智能手机生物传感的多色多孔硅 RGB 梳状滤光片
data.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，我们报告了一种基于多孔硅的多色梳状滤光片，可以从智能手机提供的白光照明中选择红色 (R)、绿色 (G) 和蓝色 (B) 波长。所有三个色带的半峰全宽均低于 30 nm。使用光谱仪进行光谱表征，并对滤波器的智能手机图像进行色彩分析，以验证所需的性能。将智能手机 LED 闪光灯的白光转换为多色 RGB 照明可用于基于智能手机的生物传感，以提高检测限。

data.title: Multichannel hybrid quantum cryptography for submarine optical communications
data.author: Jesús Liñares, Xesús Prieto-Blanco, Alexandre Vázquez-Martínez, Eduardo F. Mateo
data.summary: We present a multichannel hybrid quantum cryptography approach intended for submarine quantum optical communications between Alice and Bob separated by a distance beyond the current QKD possibilities, each located on a coastline. It is based on the difficulty of simultaneous access to M optical submarine channels. The optical lines from the coastline, and ideally to the end of the continental shelf, are governed by the quantum properties of the light under an autocompensating high-dimensional discrete-modulation continuous variable QKD protocol. The hybrid approach consists of combining several secret keys of M channels and introducing extra layers of security, passive and/or active, on the non-quantum optical lines located beyond the continental shelf.
data.title_cn: 用于海底光通信的多通道混合量子密码
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种多通道混合量子加密方法，旨在用于 Alice 和 Bob 之间的海底量子光通信，两者之间的距离超出了当前 QKD 可能性，每个都位于海岸线上。它是基于同时接入M个光海底通道的难度。从海岸线（理想情况下到大陆架末端）的光路由自动补偿高维离散调制连续变量 QKD 协议下的光的量子特性控制。混合方法包括组合 M 通道的多个密钥，并在位于大陆架以外的非量子光线路上引入额外的安全层（无源和/或有源）。

data.title: Design of a compact four-lens collimation system with integrated light recycling
data.author: Shutao Zheng, Yiqin Xu, Zhiqing Zhang, Zhongrui Qu, Zhiliang Gu, Shuwen Zheng
data.summary: High-radiance LED illumination systems utilizing incoherent light sources are typically limited by an inherent trade-off between achievable radiance and overall system volume. To overcome this constraint, we designed and fabricated a compact four-lens collimation system with integrated light recycling (ILRC) that combines a freeform surface lens group with a reflective ring structure to efficiently redistribute and recapture divergent light. Ray tracing analysis was performed by three discrete wavelengths (385, 430, and 475 nm) to evaluate key system parameters, including aperture, reflectivity, scattering behavior, and LED chip area. Compared to commercially available alternatives, the ILRC system achieves a reduction in total volume by nearly 50% while increasing the radiant intensity at 385 nm by approximately 65%. When implemented in optical microscopy, the system provided significantly enhanced effective radiance at the sample plane and improved image contrast, confirming its utility as a compact, energy-efficient, and high-radiance illumination solution.
data.title_cn: 具有集成光回收功能的紧凑型四透镜准直系统的设计
data.abstract_cn: 利用非相干光源的高亮度 LED 照明系统通常受到可实现的亮度和整个系统体积之间固有权衡的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们设计并制造了一种具有集成光回收（ILRC）功能的紧凑型四透镜准直系统，该系统将自由曲面透镜组与反射环结构相结合，以有效地重新分配和重新捕获发散光。通过三个离散波长（385、430 和 475 nm）进行光线追踪分析，以评估关键系统参数，包括孔径、反射率、散射行为和 LED 芯片面积。与市售替代品相比，ILRC 系统的总体积减少了近 50%，同时 385 nm 的辐射强度增加了约 65%。当在光学显微镜中实施时，该系统在样品平面上提供了显着增强的有效辐射度并改善了图像对比度，证实了其作为紧凑、节能和高辐射度照明解决方案的实用性。

data.title: Development of internal defect detection equipment for composite materials based on shear speckle interference
data.author: ZhiYong Peng, Biao Gu, JiaHao Zhao, Qilin Zeng, YuLong Qiao
data.summary: To address the limitations of slow phase-shifting speed and low hardware integration in traditional composite defect detection systems, a portable device was developed that integrates a Wollaston prism shearing module with a high-speed liquid crystal phase retarder. The main contribution of this work is an improved real-time phase unwrapping process for shear speckle interferometry measurements, achieved by combining gradient-adaptive smoothing with graph-cut optimization and deploying it on an embedded GPU platform. Embedded software and GPU-accelerated algorithms were incorporated to enhance processing efficiency. An improved algorithm combining gradient-adaptive smoothing and graph-cut optimization was proposed for noise suppression in phase unwrapping, reducing the root mean square error (RMSE) by 27.34% to 33.20% under hybrid noise conditions and completing single-frame analysis within 0.36 s. Experimental validation using aluminum discs and composite specimens showed that the reliable detection of internal defects with a diameter of ≥2mm under heat loading achieved 97% accuracy. The system’s integrated hardware–software design achieves submillimeter resolution while maintaining field-deployable portability, fulfilling critical requirements for high-speed, high-sensitivity nondestructive testing in aerospace applications.
data.title_cn: 基于剪切散斑干涉的复合材料内部缺陷检测设备研制
data.abstract_cn: 为了解决传统复合材料缺陷检测系统相移速度慢和硬件集成度低的限制，开发了一种集成了沃拉斯顿棱镜剪切模块和高速液晶相位延迟器的便携式设备。这项工作的主要贡献是改进了剪切散斑干涉测量的实时相位展开过程，通过将梯度自适应平滑与图割优化相结合并将其部署在嵌入式 GPU 平台上来实现。结合嵌入式软件和 GPU 加速算法来提高处理效率。提出了一种结合梯度自适应平滑和图割优化的改进算法来抑制相位展开中的噪声，在混合噪声条件下将均方根误差（RMSE）降低了27.34%至33.20%，并在0.36 s内完成单帧分析。使用铝盘和复合试件进行的实验验证表明，在热载荷下可靠检测直径≥2mm的内部缺陷，准确率达到97%。该系统的集成硬件软件设计实现了亚毫米分辨率，同时保持了现场部署的便携性，满足航空航天应用中高速、高灵敏度无损检测的关键要求。

data.title: Comparison of a compact imaging spectrometer with long-slit designs utilizing various modified Offner structures and freeform surface grating-prism dispersion elements
data.author: Chen Zhang, Xianglong Mao, Jiadong Yu, Junming Chen, Ruitong Wu
data.summary: To address application demands for long slits, high spectral resolution, and compact system design, traditional Offner-type freeform surface imaging spectrometers face challenges of excessively high grating line density and manufacturing complexity. This paper proposes an innovative design for an off-axis three-mirror imaging spectrometer featuring a grating-prism combination with dispersion-corrected freeform surfaces. Building upon a modified Offner structure, the secondary mirror employs a freeform surface grating while prisms are systematically integrated into the optical path to share dispersion and synergistically correct aberrations. By configuring varying numbers (1–3) of prisms (only one being a freeform surface prism) at three critical locations—the input arm, secondary mirror, and output arm—12 distinct design configurations are achieved. A grating imaging spectrometer was concurrently designed for comparison. The resulting designs were rigorously compared against requirements: a wavelength range spanning from 400 to 1000 nm, a spectral resolution of 3 nm, a slit length of 60 mm, and an F-number of 3. Among these designs, a particular configuration demonstrated modulation transfer (MTF values) surpassing 0.7 at the Nyquist frequency of 34 lp/mm in full wavelengths while maintaining the smile and keystone less than one-tenth that of the pixel size. Tolerance analysis confirms that these freeform surfaces can be manufactured effectively. This design fulfills the criteria for both long slit functionality and compact architecture.
data.title_cn: 采用各种改进的奥夫纳结构和自由曲面光栅棱镜色散元件的紧凑型成像光谱仪与长缝设计的比较
data.abstract_cn: 为了满足长缝、高光谱分辨率和紧凑系统设计的应用需求，传统的奥夫纳型自由曲面成像光谱仪面临光栅线密度过高和制造复杂性的挑战。本文提出了一种离轴三镜成像光谱仪的创新设计，该光谱仪具有光栅棱镜组合和色散校正自由曲面。基于改进的奥夫纳结构，次镜采用自由曲面光栅，而棱镜系统地集成到光路中以共享色散并协同校正像差。通过在三个关键位置（输入臂、次镜和输出臂）配置不同数量 (1-3) 的棱镜（只有一个是自由曲面棱镜），可实现 12 种不同的设计配置。同时设计了光栅成像光谱仪进行比较。最终的设计与要求进行了严格比较：波长范围从 400 纳米到 1000 纳米，光谱分辨率为 3 纳米，狭缝长度为 60 毫米，F 数为 3。在这些设计中，特定配置证明在全波长 34 lp/mm 的奈奎斯特频率下调制传递（MTF 值）超过 0.7，同时保持微笑和梯形失真小于像素尺寸的十分之一。公差分析证实这些自由曲面可以有效制造。该设计满足长狭缝功能和紧凑架构的标准。

data.title: Distributions of purple-light colors and spectra in clear twilights
data.author: Raymond L. Lee
data.summary: Clear civil twilights often exhibit a range of pastel purples, but the combined angular and temporal distributions of this purple light are unknown. Such distributions can now be measured by using a hyperspectral camera fitted with a fisheye lens, which gives new insights into the spread and evolution of purple-light spectra and colors during ordinary (i.e., nonvolcanic) clear twilights. Because the purple light lacks clear-cut borders, a first step is to develop a perceptually based definition of its angular extent. Surprisingly, this leads to the discovery that colorimetrically distinct purples (1) sometimes appear in both the solar and antisolar skies and (2) change in markedly different ways with sun elevation.
data.title_cn: 晴朗暮色中紫光颜色和光谱的分布
data.abstract_cn: 清澈的民用暮光通常会呈现出一系列柔和的紫色，但这种紫色光的组合角度和时间分布尚不清楚。现在可以使用配备鱼眼镜头的高光谱相机来测量这种分布，这为普通（即非火山）晴朗暮光期间紫色光谱和颜色的传播和演变提供了新的见解。由于紫色光缺乏清晰的边界，因此第一步是对其角度范围制定基于感知的定义。令人惊讶的是，这导致了以下发现：（1）有时会在太阳和反太阳天空中出现色度不同的紫色；（2）随着太阳高度的变化以明显不同的方式变化。

data.title: Subsurface mechanical damage of fused silica glass during grinding by various sub-aperture tools with and without ultrasonics
data.author: T. Suratwala, W. Steele, G. Tham, J. Ross, J. Johnson, O. Herrera, M. Cahill, D. Bechtold, M. Bechtold, R. Bechtold, F. Ravizza
data.summary: The subsurface mechanical damage (SSD) depth after grinding fused silica glass with a comprehensive set of sub-aperture fixed abrasive grinding tools [cup, wheel, belt, pad, and rotary face mill (with and without ultrasonics)] and process parameters has been statistically measured using the taper wedge technique and evaluated. Consistent with a previously reported grinding model [ J. Non-Cryst. Solids 352 , 5601 –5617 ( 2006 ) 10.1016/j.jnoncrysol.2006.09.012 , Materials Science and Technology of Optical Fabrication (Wiley & Sons, 2018 ) ], based on the sliding indentation fracture by sliding particles or asperities where the normal load per particle determines the depth of the fracture (and ultimately the overall SSD depth), the dominant factor controlling SSD depth was found to be the abrasive size regardless of the tool type and process conditions. Compared to full aperture grinding methods, the overall SSD depth was higher using the sub-aperture tools, likely due to the higher effective pressure and higher load per particle distribution. In addition to abrasive size, a significant reduction in SSD depth was achieved by: (1) reducing the load distribution on the abrasive particles via increase in contact area and/or decrease in mechanical loading; (2) using a more compliant host tool medium; and (3) in what we believe is a more novel way, using ultrasonics. Combining low abrasive size, larger contact area, and a compliant host, the 6 µm diamond in a resin matrix (Trizact) on a foam pad led to very low SSD depth (∼4.6µm), relatively fast grinding rate (186mm 3 /h), and little or no figure degradation. This grinding tool/process is an attractive choice for final grind, resulting in significantly reduced polish out (i.e., “grey out”) times. With the rotary face mill tool, the use of ultrasonics consistently led to a SSD depth reduction (ranging from 17%–34%). A new fracture mechanics-based model, to the best of our knowledge, where the relevant normal load is parallel to the feed direction, has been developed to explain how ultrasonics leads to lower SSD depth. The key factors, supported by finite element stress analysis and load measurements, are (1) the initiation of fractures at higher z heights during the tool’s ultrasonic vertical oscillations, thus propagating less deep into workpiece; (2) reduction in load (and therefore reduction in fracture propagation distance) due to smaller tool-workpiece feed direction contact area (again caused by higher z heights relative to depth of cut); (3) upward movement of the tool during oscillation leads to fracturing toward the surface instead into the depth; and finally (4) at tool’s lowest point of oscillation cycle, there may not be enough time for the fracture to propagate to its full length.
data.title_cn: 使用和不使用超声波的各种小孔径工具研磨过程中熔融石英玻璃的亚表面机械损伤
data.abstract_cn: 使用一整套小孔径固定磨料磨具 [杯、轮、带、垫和旋转面铣刀（带和不带超声波）] 磨削熔融石英玻璃后的亚表面机械损伤 (SSD) 深度和工艺参数已使用锥度楔块技术进行统计测量和评估。与先前报道的研磨模型一致[J. Non-Cryst。 Solids 352 , 5601 –5617 ( 2006 ) 10.1016/j.jnoncrysol.2006.09.012 , 材料科学与光学制造技术 (Wiley & Sons, 2018 ) ]，基于滑动颗粒或粗糙体的滑动压痕断裂，其中每个颗粒的法向载荷决定断裂深度（最终决定整体 SSD 深度），研究发现，无论刀具类型和工艺条件如何，控制 SSD 深度的主导因素是磨料尺寸。与全孔径研磨方法相比，使用子孔径工具的整体 SSD 深度更高，这可能是由于更高的有效压力和每颗粒分布的更高负载。除了磨料尺寸外，SSD 深度的显着减小还通过以下方式实现：(1) 通过增加接触面积和/或减少机械载荷来减少磨料颗粒上的载荷分布； (2)使用更兼容的宿主工具介质； (3) 我们认为这是一种更新颖的方式，即使用超声波。泡沫垫上的树脂基体 (Trizact) 中的 6 µm 金刚石结合了较小的磨料尺寸、较大的接触面积和兼容的主体，可实现非常低的 SSD 深度 (∼4.6µm)、相对较快的研磨速率 (186mm 3 /h) 以及很少或没有形状退化。这种研磨工具/工艺对于最终研磨来说是一个有吸引力的选择，可显着减少抛光（即“灰化”）时间。通过旋转面铣刀，超声波的使用始终导致 SSD 深度减少（范围为 17%–34%）。据我们所知，已经开发出一种新的基于断裂力学的模型，其中相关法向载荷平行于进给方向，用于解释超声波如何导致较低的 SSD 深度。由有限元应力分析和载荷测量支持的关键因素是（1）在工具的超声波垂直振荡期间，在较高的 z 高度处开始断裂，从而传播到工件的深度较小； (2) 由于刀具-工件进给方向接触面积较小（同样是由相对于切削深度的较高 z 高度引起），负载减少（从而减少断裂扩展距离）； (3) 工具在振荡过程中向上运动导致破裂向地表而不是向深处破裂；最后（4）在工具振荡周期的最低点，可能没有足够的时间让裂缝扩展至其全长。

data.title: 3D-DeepZern: a deep convolutional neural network for tomographic reconstruction based on Zernike polynomials
data.author: Quang Trieu, Dominick Rizk, George Nehmetallah
data.summary: Traditional analytical Zernike methods for tomographic encoding require multiplying large Zernike polynomial matrices, which leads to substantial computational overhead. Moreover, the inverse Zernike matrices must be precomputed and stored, resulting in significant memory consumption—an issue that becomes increasingly severe as the Zernike order or tomogram resolution grows. To address these limitations, we propose 3D-DeepZern, a deep learning-based Zernike polynomials that replaces the matrix-based encoding with neural networks. The method efficiently maps a 3D tomogram to its 1D Zernike descriptor vector and reconstructs the tomogram from this encoding. Compared with the analytical approach, 3D-DeepZern provides dramatically faster encoding, substantially lower memory usage, and comparable reconstruction accuracy. The improvements become even more pronounced at higher Zernike orders or larger voxel grids, demonstrating the scalability and practicality of the proposed method for high-resolution tomographic applications.
data.title_cn: 3D-DeepZern：基于 Zernike 多项式的断层扫描重建深度卷积神经网络
data.abstract_cn: 用于断层扫描编码的传统分析泽尼克方法需要乘以大型泽尼克多项式矩阵，这会导致大量的计算开销。此外，逆泽尼克矩阵必须预先计算和存储，导致显着的内存消耗——随着泽尼克阶数或断层图像分辨率的增长，这个问题变得越来越严重。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 3D-DeepZern，这是一种基于深度学习的 Zernike 多项式，用神经网络代替基于矩阵的编码。该方法有效地将 3D 断层图映射到其 1D Zernike 描述符向量，并根据该编码重建断层图。与分析方法相比，3D-DeepZern 提供了显着更快的编码、显着降低的内存使用量以及相当的重建精度。这些改进在更高的泽尼克阶数或更大的体素网格下变得更加明显，证明了所提出的方法对于高分辨率断层摄影应用的可扩展性和实用性。

data.title: 40 µm core diameter ytterbium-doped VLMA fiber for high-peak-power nanosecond pulse amplification
data.author: A. Chervet, B. Leconte, K. Wondraczek, J. Didierjean, R. Jamier, P. Roy
data.summary: In the context of microelectronic processing applications, the development of nanosecond infrared pulsed laser sources with high peak and average power is essential to support the ongoing effort to improve machining productivity. In this paper, we propose a master oscillator fiber power amplifier (MOFPA) featuring an innovative design of a polarization-maintaining (PM) very large mode area (VLMA) ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier. This fiber possesses a mode field diameter (MFD) of 38±2µm and demonstrates significant pump absorption, a combination of properties that effectively pushes back the onset of nonlinear effects in terms of peak power.
data.title_cn: 用于高峰值功率纳秒脉冲放大的 40 µm 纤芯直径掺镱 VLMA 光纤
data.abstract_cn: 在微电子加工应用中，开发具有高峰值和平均功率的纳秒红外脉冲激光源对于支持不断提高加工生产率的努力至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种主振荡器光纤功率放大器（MOFPA），其特点是保偏（PM）超大模式面积（VLMA）掺镱光纤放大器的创新设计。该光纤的模场直径 (MFD) 为 38±2μm，并表现出显着的泵浦吸收，这些特性的组合可以有效地推迟峰值功率方面非线性效应的出现。

data.title: Sulfate phantoms to mimic NIR photoacoustic response of whole blood at selected oxygen saturations
data.author: Léa Davenet, Arthur Billon, Jacques Battaglia, Lori Bridal, Jerome Gateau
data.summary: This paper presents a practical guide to prepare inorganic solutions that mimic the photoacoustic properties of whole blood at specific levels of oxygenation in the range of 700 nm to 850 nm, both in terms of optical absorption properties and the Gr{\"u}neisen coefficient. The goal is to provide aqueous solutions that can be injected in tissue-mimicking imaging phantoms to test the sensitivity and spectral capabilities of photoacoustic imaging systems operating at multiple wavelengths to estimate blood oxygenation.
data.title_cn: 硫酸盐模型模拟全血在选定氧饱和度下的近红外光声响应
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种实用指南，用于制备在 700 nm 至 850 nm 范围内的特定氧合水平下模拟全血光声特性的无机溶液，无论是在光学吸收特性还是 Gr{\"u}neisen 系数方面。目标是提供可注射到模拟组织成像体模中的水溶液，以测试在多个波长下工作的光声成像系统的灵敏度和光谱能力，以估计血液氧合。

data.title: Continuous terahertz radiation based on an L-band 500 MHz step-stable two laser beat-frequency source
data.author: Zepeng Wu, Mingxing Li, Jiaxin Yu, Shaofei Wang, Lei Yu, Qing Yan, Shuo Su, Wenjun He, Yajun You, Yi Liu, Xiujian Chou, Le Zhang, Yunpeng Shao
data.summary: This paper presents continuous terahertz (THz) radiation based on an L-Band 500 MHz step-stable two laser beat-frequency source (TL-BFS), with a frequency tuning range covering 0.1–2.7 THz. An all-polarization-maintaining (PM) fiber link was designed, including a PM isolator, a PM coupler, and a PM erbium-doped optical fiber amplifier (EDFA), to maintain a consistent polarization state between the two beams of light. An InGaAs high-performance photoconductive antenna (PCA) is excited by TL-BFS, generating continuous 0.1–2.7 THz radiation within the wavelength range of 1568.8–1589.6 nm. The THz power and frequency were tested respectively using a Golay detector and a THz scanning Fabry–Perot interferometer (TSFPI). The results show that the power instability of THz waves within 25 min is within 4%, and the frequency of 0.1, 0.5, and 1 THz are highly consistent with the interval frequencies of the TL-BFS. High-precision tuning of 500 MHz was achieved within the range of 0.95–1 THz, corresponding to a wavelength interval of 0.004 nm. At the same time, it was also proven in the THz absorption spectroscopy analysis of tyrosine samples, with a distinct absorption peak successfully detected at 0.968 THz. These results demonstrate the excellent tunning accuracy and stability of the system, highlighting its suitability for high-resolution spectroscopy.
data.title_cn: 基于 L 波段 500 MHz 步进稳定双激光拍频源的连续太赫兹辐射
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了基于 L 波段 500 MHz 步进稳定双激光拍频源 (TL-BFS) 的连续太赫兹 (THz) 辐射，频率调谐范围覆盖 0.1–2.7 THz。设计了全保偏（PM）光纤链路，包括保偏隔离器、保偏耦合器和保偏掺铒光纤放大器（EDFA），以保持两束光之间一致的偏振状态。 InGaAs 高性能光电导天线 (PCA) 由 TL-BFS 激发，在 1568.8–1589.6 nm 波长范围内产生连续的 0.1–2.7 THz 辐射。分别使用Golay探测器和太赫兹扫描法布里-珀罗干涉仪（TSFPI）测试太赫兹功率和频率。结果表明，25 min内太赫兹波功率不稳定性在4%以内，0.1、0.5、1 THz频率与TL-BFS的间隔频率高度一致。在0.95-1 THz范围内实现了500 MHz的高精度调谐，对应0.004 nm的波长间隔。同时，在酪氨酸样品的太赫兹吸收光谱分析中也得到了证明，在0.968太赫兹成功检测到了明显的吸收峰。这些结果证明了系统出色的调谐精度和稳定性，凸显了其对高分辨率光谱的适用性。

data.title: Simulation of ray-traced fringes and Zernike-based reconstruction of elliptical optical surfaces
data.author: Dahi Ghareab Abdelsalam Ibrahim, Nicholas Devaney
data.summary: This study presents a comprehensive modeling and reconstruction framework for high-precision elliptical mirrors using simulated fringe patterns and Zernike polynomial fitting. A synthetic elliptical surface is generated, featuring a dome-shaped curvature with a radius of −1300 mm, major and minor axes of 229 and 124 mm, respectively, and sub-wavelength flatness and roughness characteristics. The surface is divided into 180 radial profiles using the non-interpolated profile rotation model (N-IPRM), which preserves native spatial sampling. To address discontinuities inherent in radial reconstruction, the interpolated profile rotation model (IPRM) applies shape-preserving interpolation to enable smooth surface recovery. Sag and slope equations derived from the interpolated profiles are used in a custom ray-tracing algorithm to simulate interference fringes at both visible (0.0006328 mm) and millimeter-wave (5.052296 mm) wavelengths. The algorithm incorporates planar, spherical, and oppositely curved spherical reference surfaces relative to the elliptical surface. The simulated fringe patterns undergo thinning and fringe order estimation, followed by surface reconstruction using a custom Zernike polynomial fitting algorithm implemented in MATLAB. Due to the challenges posed by incomplete circular fringes in Zernike-based reconstruction of elliptical surfaces, we propose a novel approach, to our knowledge: transforming the elliptical surface into an equivalent spherical surface, performing the reconstruction, and then converting it back to the original elliptical form. The reconstructed surface shows excellent agreement with the model, achieving an absolute error of 0.0161 mm and a relative error of 0.32% along the major axis at the longer wavelength. Symmetry deviations of approximately 0.5% further validate the reconstruction accuracy. This methodology provides a robust and versatile toolset for the simulation, analysis, and precise reconstruction of elliptical optical surfaces, with significant implications for optical fabrication and metrology.
data.title_cn: 光线追踪条纹模拟和基于 Zernike 的椭圆光学表面重建
data.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了使用模拟条纹图案和泽尼克多项式拟合的高精度椭圆镜的综合建模和重建框架。生成一个合成椭圆形表面，具有半径为 -1300 mm 的圆顶形曲率、长轴和短轴分别为 229 和 124 mm，以及亚波长平坦度和粗糙度特征。使用非插值轮廓旋转模型 (N-IPRM) 将表面分为 180 个径向轮廓，该模型保留了原生空间采样。为了解决径向重建中固有的不连续性，插值轮廓旋转模型 (IPRM) 应用保形插值来实现平滑的表面恢复。从插值轮廓导出的垂度和斜率方程用于自定义光线追踪算法，以模拟可见光 (0.0006328 mm) 和毫米波 (5.052296 mm) 波长的干涉条纹。该算法结合了平面、球形和相对于椭圆形表面相反弯曲的球形参考表面。模拟的条纹图案经过细化和条纹阶次估计，然后使用在 MATLAB 中实现的自定义 Zernike 多项式拟合算法进行表面重建。由于基于Zernike的椭圆面重建中不完整的圆条纹带来的挑战，据我们所知，我们提出了一种新颖的方法：将椭圆面变换为等效球面，进行重建，然后将其转换回原始椭圆形式。重建表面与模型表现出极好的一致性，在较长波长下沿主轴的绝对误差为 0.0161 mm，相对误差为 0.32%。约 0.5% 的对称偏差进一步验证了重建精度。该方法为椭圆光学表面的模拟、分析和精确重建提供了强大且通用的工具集，对光学制造和计量具有重要意义。

data.title: Demodulation of a fiber Fabry–Perot sensor by a speckle-based silicon chip
data.author: Zhipeng Wu, Qinlei Liu, Zhihang Lin, Huafei Mao, Xiao Liu, Qinggang Lin, Yanghui Li, Juan Kang, Yi Li
data.summary: Fabry–Perot (FP) interferometric sensors are widely employed for precise measurements of temperature, strain, and pressure. However, conventional demodulation methods face inherent trade-offs among accuracy, dynamic range, and real-time performance. Herein, we propose and experimentally validate a fiber FP sensor system based on a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) chip. The demodulation principle is on the basis of mapping environmentally induced spectral shifts into speckle patterns through multimode interferences. In this study, an Archimedean spiral bidirectional multimode waveguide (MMW) is employed to replace conventional multimode fibers, enabling higher integration, simplified packaging, and improved environmental robustness. The speckle patterns are subsequently converted into eight-channel intensity signals for easier data acquisition. In the demonstration experiments, a temperature measurement accuracy of 0.02°C was achieved while maintaining excellent long-term stability. Further analysis reveals that the employed SOI chip exhibits a wavelength sensitivity of 1 pm, corresponding to a theoretical temperature resolution better than 0.001°C. Overall, the speckle-based SOI chip provides a solution for FP sensor systems that features high precision, excellent stability, and a broad dynamic range.
data.title_cn: 通过散斑硅芯片解调光纤法布里-珀罗传感器
data.abstract_cn: 法布里-珀罗 (FP) 干涉传感器广泛用于温度、应变和压力的精确测量。然而，传统的解调方法面临着精度、动态范围和实时性能之间固有的权衡。在此，我们提出并实验验证了基于绝缘体上硅 (SOI) 芯片的光纤 FP 传感器系统。解调原理基于通过多模干涉将环境引起的光谱偏移映射为散斑图案。在这项研究中，采用阿基米德螺旋双向多模波导（MMW）来取代传统的多模光纤，从而实现更高的集成度、简化的封装并提高环境鲁棒性。随后将散斑图案转换为八通道强度信号，以便于数据采集。在演示实验中，实现了 0.02°C 的温度测量精度，同时保持了出色的长期稳定性。进一步分析表明，所采用的 SOI 芯片具有 1 pm 的波长灵敏度，对应于优于 0.001°C 的理论温度分辨率。总体而言，基于散斑的SOI芯片为FP传感器系统提供了一种解决方案，具有高精度、出色的稳定性和宽动态范围。

data.title: Two-dimensional fiber Bragg grating accelerometer with four identical cantilevers
data.author: Meiya Zhang, Qiang Zhao, Peng Sun, Yunzhou Li, Zhen Wang
data.summary: To address the requirements of two-dimensional (2D) low-frequency vibration monitoring and sensor miniaturization, this paper proposes a compact 2D fiber Bragg grating (FBG) acceleration sensor with four identical cantilever beams. The sensor uses four identical cantilever beams as elastic sensing elements. By applying differential signal processing to the variations in the central wavelength of the FBGs, it suppresses temperature cross-sensitivity and enhances measurement sensitivity. The experimental results demonstrate resonant frequencies of 500 (X-axis) and 525 Hz (Y-axis), with stable operation in the 10–200 Hz range, sensitivities of 38.01 and 38.10 pm/g with excellent linearity (r 2 >0.99), crosstalk ratios of 11.6% and 13.7%, and differential temperature sensitivities of only 1.7–2 pm/°C. Owing to its miniaturized structure and consistent bidirectional sensitivity, the sensor is highly suitable for two-dimensional low-frequency vibration monitoring in space-constrained environments and in scenarios with strong electromagnetic interference (EMI).
data.title_cn: 具有四个相同悬臂梁的二维光纤布拉格光栅加速度计
data.abstract_cn: 为了满足二维（2D）低频振动监测和传感器小型化的要求，本文提出了一种具有四个相同悬臂梁的紧凑型二维光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）加速度传感器。该传感器采用四个相同的悬臂梁作为弹性传感元件。通过对光纤光栅中心波长的变化进行差分信号处理，可以抑制温度交叉敏感性并提高测量灵敏度。实验结果表明，谐振频率为 500 Hz（X 轴）和 525 Hz（Y 轴），在 10–200 Hz 范围内稳定运行，灵敏度为 38.01 和 38.10 pm/g，具有出色的线性度（r 2 >0.99），串扰比为 11.6% 和 13.7%，温差灵敏度仅为 1.7–2下午/°C。由于其小型化的结构和一致的双向灵敏度，该传感器非常适合空间受限环境和强电磁干扰（EMI）场景下的二维低频振动监测。

data.title: Air-processed CuSCN hole-injection layer with improved surface properties for performance enhancement of quantum dot light-emitting diodes
data.author: Shilong Shi, Yuanhong Hu, Mingyue Liao, Yanlian Lei, Xuejun Qiu
data.summary: Copper (I) thiocyanate (CuSCN) is a highly promising hole-injection layer (HIL) for optoelectronic devices due to its excellent hole mobility, optical transparency, and solution-processability. However, challenges related to defect states and film quality persist. This study presents a simple strategy for air-induced surface chemical restructuring of CuSCN films, effectively reducing surface defects and increasing covalent character. Results show that quantum-dot light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) fabricated with air-processed CuSCN HIL demonstrate approximately two-fold improvements in both brightness and efficiency compared to devices made in nitrogen atmospheres. These findings offer valuable insights for the development of cost-effective, high-brightness QLEDs, applicable across various transport layer systems.
data.title_cn: 空气处理的 CuSCN 空穴注入层具有改善的表面性能，可增强量子点发光二极管的性能
data.abstract_cn: 硫氰酸铜 (I) (CuSCN) 具有优异的空穴迁移率、光学透明度和溶液加工性能，是一种非常有前景的光电器件空穴注入层 (HIL)。然而，与缺陷状态和薄膜质量相关的挑战仍然存在。本研究提出了一种空气诱导 CuSCN 薄膜表面化学重组的简单策略，有效减少表面缺陷并增加共价特性。结果表明，与氮气气氛中制造的器件相比，采用空气处理的 CuSCN HIL 制造的量子点发光二极管 (QLED) 在亮度和效率方面均提高了大约两倍。这些发现为开发适用于各种传输层系统的经济高效、高亮度 QLED 提供了宝贵的见解。

data.title: Cavity-enhanced polarization-independent frequency conversion for vector beams
data.author: Ren-Hui Chen, Zhi-Cheng Guo, Zheng-Bang Ju, Ming-Yuan Gao, Zhao-Qi-Zhi Han, Yue-Wei Song, Xiao-Hua Wang, Yin-Hai Li, Yan Li, Wei Zhang, Zhi-Yuan Zhou, Bao-Sen Shi
data.summary: Vector beams with spatially varying polarization, represented on the higher-order Poincaré sphere, are indispensable in optical communications, imaging, and quantum information science. However, nonlinear frequency conversion of vector beams remains challenging due to sensitivity and limited conversion efficiency. Here, we demonstrate a highly efficient, external-cavity-enhanced, polarization-independent frequency conversion based on difference-frequency generation for vector beams. Benefiting from cavity enhancement within the Sagnac configuration, we achieve external quantum efficiencies of 43.85% and 16.83% for vector beams with l =1 and l =2, respectively, demonstrating efficient continuous-wave frequency conversion. The preservation of the vectorial polarization structure in the converted beams is verified by spatial Stokes measurements. This work demonstrates an efficient approach for wavelength manipulation of vector beams and is potentially relevant to applications in structured-light control and nonlinear photonic interfaces.
data.title_cn: 矢量光束的腔增强型偏振无关频率转换
data.abstract_cn: 在高阶庞加莱球上表示的具有空间变化偏振的矢量光束在光通信、成像和量子信息科学中是不可或缺的。然而，由于灵敏度和有限的转换效率，矢量光束的非线性频率转换仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了一种基于矢量光束差频生成的高效、外腔增强、与偏振无关的频率转换。受益于 Sagnac 配置内的腔体增强，我们在 l =1 和 l =2 的矢量光束上分别实现了 43.85% 和 16.83% 的外部量子效率，证明了高效的连续波频率转换。通过空间斯托克斯测量验证了转换光束中矢量偏振结构的保留。这项工作展示了一种有效的矢量光束波长操纵方法，并且可能与结构光控制和非线性光子接口的应用相关。

data.title: Magnetic field direction detection using electromagnetically induced transparency with a vector vortex beam
data.author: Owen Rollins, Eugeniy E. Mikhailov, Irina Novikova
data.summary: We experimentally demonstrate how one can measure the magnetic field direction using electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) with a vector vortex laser beam. Unwrapping the intensity variation along the vortex allows to simultaneously obtain information about EIT resonance amplitudes for all laser polarizations from one differential intensity image. We demonstrate that one can determine the orientation of the transverse component of the magnetic field with sub-degree precision by tracking the angular position of EIT amplitude extrema. Fourier analysis of the peaks’ azimuthal dependence enables unambiguous identification of the angle between the magnetic field and the laser propagation direction (longitudinal angle). The proposed method is fully compatible with EIT-based magnetometers, and particularly attractive for integrated assemblies, since it does not require any active polarization rotators.
data.title_cn: 使用电磁感应透明体和矢量涡旋光束进行磁场方向检测
data.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验演示了如何使用电磁感应透明 (EIT) 和矢量涡旋激光束来测量磁场方向。解开沿涡旋的强度变化可以同时从一张差分强度图像中获取有关所有激光偏振的 EIT 共振振幅的信息。我们证明，通过跟踪 EIT 振幅极值的角位置，可以以亚度精度确定磁场横向分量的方向。对峰值方位角依赖性的傅立叶分析可以明确识别磁场与激光传播方向（纵向角）之间的角度。所提出的方法与基于 EIT 的磁力计完全兼容，并且对于集成组件特别有吸引力，因为它不需要任何有源偏振旋转器。

data.title: Polarization-multiplexed co-transmission of continuous-variable QKD and quantum noise stream cipher
data.author: Yuchao Liu, Tao Wang, Peng Huang, Guihua Zeng
data.summary: Quantum noise stream cipher (QNSC) is an encryption technique that leverages redundant information obscured by quantum noise to achieve an exponential increase in attack complexity, while continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) can provide such redundant information by generating secret keys. Notably, the optical architectures employed in these two schemes exhibit significant similarities. In this work, we employ polarization division multiplexing (PDM) to enhance channel capacity, enabling simultaneous transmission of signals under two different protocols over a single channel. To mitigate dynamic polarization state variations induced during signal propagation, we implement a polarization-interleaved subcarrier modulation (PISCM) scheme. We demonstrate that at a transmission distance of 20 km, the QKD secure key rate can be maintained at 4.93 Mbps, while the QNSC transmission rate reaches 100 Mbps. The expansion of the key rate from 4 Mbps to 400 Mbps using a linear feedback shift register (LFSR) enables synchronization with the 100 Mbps QNSC signal, realizing a promising pathway toward an integrated communication and encryption system.
data.title_cn: 连续可变 QKD 和量子噪声流密码的偏振复用共传
data.abstract_cn: 量子噪声流密码（QNSC）是一种利用量子噪声掩盖的冗余信息来实现攻击复杂性呈指数级增长的加密技术，而连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）可以通过生成密钥来提供此类冗余信息。值得注意的是，这两种方案中采用的光学架构表现出显着的相似性。在这项工作中，我们采用偏振分复用（PDM）来增强信道容量，从而能够在单个信道上同时传输两种不同协议下的信号。为了减轻信号传播过程中引起的动态偏振态变化，我们实施了偏振交织子载波调制（PISCM）方案。我们证明，在20公里的传输距离上，QKD安全密钥速率可以保持在4.93 Mbps，而QNSC传输速率达到100 Mbps。使用线性反馈移位寄存器 (LFSR) 将密钥速率从 4 Mbps 扩展到 400 Mbps，从而实现与 100 Mbps QNSC 信号的同步，从而实现了集成通信和加密系统的一条有前途的途径。

data.title: Sub-diffraction-limit light field shaping through edge-singularity engineering
data.author: Junhui Jia, Chaoheng Guo, Haolin Lin, Jiahui Wu, Yanwen Hu, Yangjian Cai, Shenhe Fu
data.summary: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a technique for shaping the light field in the sub-diffraction regime. Our technique relies on carefully engineering a phase singularity that is distributed continuously along a transverse curve. We develop a polynomial function to effectively describe this singularity curve, which results in an arbitrary light pattern with a feature size considerably down to the deep sub-diffraction limit. We experimentally verify the theoretical framework by demonstrating different cases of edge-singularity engineering for shaping the Gaussian envelope into desired morphologies. Our demonstrations open a novel, to the best of our knowledge, pathway to shaping the light field at the sub-diffraction-limit regime, which can find potential applications in various fields including the super-resolution imaging and precision detection.
data.title_cn: 通过边缘奇点工程实现亚衍射极限光场整形
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出并通过实验演示了一种在亚衍射区域塑造光场的技术。我们的技术依赖于精心设计沿横向曲线连续分布的相位奇点。我们开发了一个多项式函数来有效地描述这种奇点曲线，从而产生特征尺寸大大降低到深亚衍射极限的任意光图案。我们通过展示边缘奇点工程的不同案例来实验验证理论框架，以将高斯包络塑造成所需的形态。据我们所知，我们的演示开辟了一条在亚衍射极限范围内塑造光场的新颖途径，它可以在包括超分辨率成像和精密检测在内的各个领域找到潜在的应用。

data.title: Ultra-precision fabrication of fused silica micro-optics by diamond turning of partially debound silica nanocomposites
data.author: Xiaodong Su, Ya Xu, Xiaotong Du, Limin Zhu, Zhiwei Zhu
data.summary: Silica nanocomposites-based processes provided a new route for low-temperature fabrication of fused silica components. However, low accuracy and poor surface quality prohibit their applications for generating fused silica optics. Herein, we report what we believe to be a novel process for ultra-precision fabrication of complex-shaped fused silica micro-optics by diamond turning of partially debound silica nanocomposites, where the partially debound nanocomposites were designed to suppress undesired deformations in the high-temperature processing. By practically characterizing the generated fused silica components, the optimum partial debinding temperature was selected as 275°C. As a demonstration, an achromatic refractive-diffractive hybrid lens with long focal depth was fabricated to have a surface roughness of Sa = 6.01 nm and a PV error of around 0.46 μm.
data.title_cn: 通过部分脱脂二氧化硅纳米复合材料的金刚石车削超精密制造熔融二氧化硅微光学器件
data.abstract_cn: 基于二氧化硅纳米复合材料的工艺为低温制造熔融二氧化硅部件提供了一条新途径。然而，低精度和差的表面质量阻碍了它们在产生熔融石英光学方面的应用。在此，我们报告了一种我们认为是通过对部分脱脂二氧化硅纳米复合材料进行金刚石车削来超精密制造复杂形状熔融石英微光学器件的新工艺，其中部分脱脂纳米复合材料旨在抑制高温加工中不需要的变形。通过对生成的熔融二氧化硅组分的实际表征，最佳部分脱脂温度选择为275℃。作为演示，我们制作了一个长焦深消色差折射-衍射混合透镜，其表面粗糙度为 Sa = 6.01 nm，PV 误差约为 0.46 μm。

data.title: All-optical subtractive convolution in photochromic absorbing media
data.author: Eugenio Fazio, Mario Bragaglia, Arif Nabizada, Francesca Nanni, Alessandro Bile
data.summary: Optical image recognition represents a promising alternative to traditional digital methods. In this paper, we present a fully optical system that performs subtraction convolution, meaning that common features between two light maps, a reference and an unknown to be recognized, are eliminated. This is due to the use of a material with induced absorption at the heart of the beam interaction: a thin film of TII photochromic molecules in epoxy resin. The increased absorption in the illuminated regions of the photochromic material causes the optical convolution between two light beams to eliminate the regions with common features, leaving only the dissimilar features in transmission. Both theoretical and experimental results demonstrate high selectivity and resolution, highlighting the great potential of photochromic materials for reconfigurable optical processors.
data.title_cn: 光致变色吸收介质中的全光减法卷积
data.abstract_cn: 光学图像识别是传统数字方法的一种有前景的替代方案。在本文中，我们提出了一个执行减法卷积的全光学系统，这意味着消除了两个光图（参考光图和待识别的未知光图）之间的共同特征。这是由于在光束相互作用的核心使用了一种具有诱导吸收的材料：环氧树脂中的 TII 光致变色分子薄膜。光致变色材料的照明区域中吸收的增加导致两束光束之间的光学卷积消除了具有共同特征的区域，仅留下透射中不同的特征。理论和实验结果都证明了高选择性和分辨率，凸显了光致变色材料在可重构光学处理器中的巨大潜力。

data.title: Quantum-induced coherence imaging with a long interference region
data.author: Yansheng Bao, Bochen Wang, Zemin Wu, Changyong Tian, Yani Zuo, Zhengyong Li
data.summary: Zou-Wang-Mandel (ZWM) quantum-induced coherence has been demonstrated for high-sensitive detection and sensing applications such as high signal-to-noise ratio ranging and imaging in complex environments. The path overlapping of the idler prohibits the determination of the exact path from which the signal originates. However, the interference region of quantum-induced coherence is limited to coherence length of parametric down-conversion (PDC) photons generated by nonlinear processes, which has remained an urgent issue to address. Here, we propose a method to increase the interference region of quantum-induced coherence imaging systems, from micrometers to centimeters at least by seed injection (SI) of the same frequency as the idler, and resulting in brighter fringes. Compared to typical ZWM quantum-induced coherence imaging, our system not only retains the advantages of noise resistance and no coincidence requirement but also exhibits possibilities of high-coherence, long-distance, and high-visibility imaging.
data.title_cn: 具有长干涉区的量子诱导相干成像
data.abstract_cn: Zou-Wang-Mandel (ZWM) 量子诱导相干性已被证明可用于高灵敏度检测和传感应用，例如复杂环境中的高信噪比测距和成像。闲频信号的路径重叠阻碍了确定信号源自的确切路径。然而，量子诱导相干的干涉区域仅限于非线性过程产生的参量下转换（PDC）光子的相干长度，这仍然是一个亟待解决的问题。在这里，我们提出了一种方法，通过与惰轮频率相同的种子注入（SI）来增加量子诱导相干成像系统的干涉区域，至少从微米到厘米，并产生更亮的条纹。与典型的ZWM量子诱导相干成像相比，我们的系统不仅保留了抗噪声和无重合要求的优点，而且还展现了高相干、远距离、高可见度成像的可能性。

data.title: Vector diffraction of aspherical wavefronts with azimuthal polarization in microscope objectives
data.author: Rafael G. González-Acuña
data.summary: The Richards–Wolf integral models electromagnetic fields in high-NA optical systems like microscopes, capturing polarization effects of azimuthally polarized beams, but is limited to spherical wavefronts, failing to account for aberrations or aspherical surfaces. A novel, to our knowledge, generalized diffraction integral [ Appl. Opt. 64 , 6036 ( 2025 ) 10.1364/AO.568541 ] extends this framework to handle freeform vectorial fields and aberrations, reducing to the classical form for spherical cases. We apply this method to compute the point spread function (PSF) of microscopes with aspherical wavefronts and azimuthal polarization, analyzing aberration impacts. Our results show improved PSF accuracy, enhancing super-resolution imaging and optical trapping and thus advancing polarization-sensitive microscopy design.
data.title_cn: 显微镜物镜中具有方位角偏振的非球面波前的矢量衍射
data.abstract_cn: 理查兹-沃尔夫积分对显微镜等高数值孔径光学系统中的电磁场进行建模，捕获方位偏振光束的偏振效应，但仅限于球面波前，无法考虑像差或非球面。据我们所知，一种新颖的广义衍射积分[Appl。选择。 64, 6036 (2025) 10.1364/AO.568541] 扩展了这个框架来处理自由矢量场和像差，简化为球面情况的经典形式。我们应用这种方法来计算具有非球面波前和方位角偏振的显微镜的点扩散函数（PSF），分析像差影响。我们的结果表明，PSF 精度得到提高，增强了超分辨率成像和光学捕获，从而推进了偏振敏感显微镜设计。

data.title: Tailorable spin-to-orbital angular momentum degree-of-freedom complete conversion with cascaded metasurfaces
data.author: Shiu Hei Lam, Jinyong Ma, Thomas Pertsch, Andrey A. Sukhorukov
data.summary: Spin-to-orbital angular momentum (OAM) conversion combined with the polarization shaping expands capabilities in optical communications and quantum optics. Whereas a single metasurface can create different OAMs depending on the input polarization, it cannot arbitrarily tailor output polarizations. We reveal how to overcome this limitation with cascaded metasurfaces, achieving complete control over the polarization and optical phase of OAMs combined with a near-unity efficiency, which can mediate the creation of quantum-entangled states. Our analytical framework of multi-channel OAM conversion predicts the optimal metasurface separation distance, and diffraction theory calculations confirm that the designed performance is preserved within nanofabrication tolerances.
data.title_cn: 可定制的自旋到轨道角动量自由度与级联超表面的完全转换
data.abstract_cn: 自旋到轨道角动量 (OAM) 转换与偏振整形相结合，扩展了光通信和量子光学的能力。虽然单个超表面可以根据输入偏振创建不同的 OAM，但它不能任意定制输出偏振。我们揭示了如何通过级联超表面克服这一限制，实现对 OAM 的偏振和光学相位的完全控制，并结合接近统一的效率，从而可以介导量子纠缠态的创建。我们的多通道 OAM 转换分析框架预测了最佳超表面分离距离，衍射理论计算证实设计的性能保持在纳米制造公差范围内。

data.title: High-energy, high-beam quality spatiotemporal mode-locked fiber laser with precise transverse mode control
data.author: Xiuquan Li, Wenqi Ma, Yi Qin, Canyi Deng, Guijun Hu
data.summary: Spatiotemporal mode-locked lasers offer unique dynamics and high-energy potential through transverse mode collaboration. However, current schemes lack precise transverse mode control, limiting the simultaneous improvement of single-pulse energy and beam quality. This paper employs a transverse mode control technique, which uses a mode multiplexer/demultiplexer to realize transverse mode division and can achieve precise control of all the transverse modes participating in spatiotemporal mode-locking (STML). Experimental results of a four-mode step-index (STIN) fiber spatiotemporal mode-locked laser demonstrate stable mode-locking at a single repetition frequency across multiple transverse modes via intermodal dispersion control using compensating fibers. Transverse mode energy superposition enables a high single-pulse energy output of 7.6 nJ in the 1.5 μm band. Furthermore, polarization controllers in each branch dynamically optimize intermodal coupling, significantly reducing the M 2 value from 4.8 to 1.4, achieving Gaussian-like high-beam-quality output in a STIN fiber spatiotemporal mode-locked laser for the first time. The technique is theoretically extensible to any number of transverse modes, enabling precise control of dispersion, phase, and polarization per mode for coordinated energy and beam quality optimization in spatiotemporal mode-locked lasers.
data.title_cn: 具有精确横模控制的高能量、高光束质量时空锁模光纤激光器
data.abstract_cn: 时空锁模激光器通过横模协作提供独特的动力学和高能潜力。然而，现有方案缺乏精确的横模控制，限制了单脉冲能量和光束质量的同时提高。本文采用横模控制技术，利用模式复用器/解复用器实现横模分割，可以实现对参与时空锁模（STML）的所有横模的精确控制。四模阶跃折射率 (STIN) 光纤时空锁模激光器的实验结果表明，通过使用补偿光纤的模间色散控制，可以在多个横向模式的单个重复频率下实现稳定的锁模。横模能量叠加可在 1.5 μm 波段实现 7.6 nJ 的高单脉冲能量输出。此外，每个分支中的偏振控制器动态优化模间耦合，将M 2 值从4.8显着降低至1.4，首次在STIN光纤时空锁模激光器中实现类高斯高光束质量输出。该技术理论上可扩展到任意数量的横向模式，从而能够精确控制每个模式的色散、相位和偏振，从而在时空锁模激光器中协调能量和光束质量优化。

data.title: Dynamic-gain-matching-based large bandwidth self-mixing laser Doppler velocimetry with notable 10 4 intensity response enhancement
data.author: Jinsong Liu, Yifan Wang, Yan Li, Xin Xu, Yidong Tan
data.summary: Laser Doppler velocimetry is a powerful method for precise motion monitoring with the advantages of high precision and noncontact. Among them, self-mixing (SM) laser Doppler velocimetry exhibits high sensitivity for noncooperative targets. The spontaneous amplification of Doppler signals through intracavity interference enables the detection of weak echo signals, meeting practical measurement requirements. However, the frequency-dependent gain profile in laser feedback systems exhibits progressive attenuation at higher frequencies due to the inherent gain-frequency constraint, fundamentally limiting their applicability for high-sensitivity velocimetry of high-speed targets. We quantitatively establish for the first time, to our knowledge, that the product of self-mixing interferometry’s gain and frequency (GFP) remains constant for higher frequency. In order to improve the bandwidth of SM laser Doppler velocimetry and further enhance the sensitivity of self-mixing interferometry (SMI), a frequency conversion method is implemented to transcend this intrinsic limit. The electro-optical modulator (EOM) and optical injection locking are employed to shift the frequency of the interference signal into the gain region, enabling the extension of gain bandwidth. Theoretically, the measurement bandwidth of Doppler frequency can extend to tens of GHz (the corresponding speed beyond 1 km/s at 1550 nm) due to the large modulation bandwidth of EOM, and the experimental measurement of Doppler frequency exceeds 44 MHz (34.1 m/s at 1550 nm) limited by the target. The system achieves a Doppler frequency measurement precision within 4 Hz. In the meantime, optical injection locking can provide additional optical gain. The seed light of 10 μW is amplified to 60 mW, providing a gain of 37 dB. The detection limit of the proposed system is −145.52 dB with 10 4 higher intensity response sensitivity than normal heterodyne interference. Therefore, the system has the advantages of large bandwidth, high sensitivity, and high precision. It is expected to be widely used in the monitoring of noncooperative high-speed moving targets.
data.title_cn: 基于动态增益匹配的大带宽自混合激光多普勒测速，具有显着的 10 4 强度响应增强
data.abstract_cn: 激光多普勒测速是一种强大的精确运动监测方法，具有高精度、非接触式的优点。其中，自混合（SM）激光多普勒测速对非合作目标表现出高灵敏度。通过腔内干扰对多普勒信号进行自发放大，实现微弱回波信号的检测，满足实际测量需求。然而，由于固有的增益频率限制，激光反馈系统中与频率相关的增益分布在较高频率下表现出渐进衰减，从根本上限制了它们在高速目标的高灵敏度测速中的适用性。据我们所知，我们首次定量地确定自混合干涉测量的增益和频率（GFP）的乘积对于较高频率保持恒定。为了提高单模激光多普勒测速的带宽，进一步提高自混合干涉测量（SMI）的灵敏度，采用变频方法来突破这一固有限制。采用电光调制器（EOM）和光注入锁定将干涉信号的频率移入增益区域，从而扩展增益带宽。理论上，由于EOM调制带宽大，多普勒频率测量带宽可以扩展到数十GHz（1550 nm处对应速度超过1 km/s），而受目标限制，多普勒频率实验测量超过44 MHz（1550 nm处34.1 m/s）。该系统实现了4 Hz以内的多普勒频率测量精度。同时，光学注入锁定可以提供额外的光学增益。 10 μW 的种子光被放大到 60 mW，提供 37 dB 的增益。所提出系统的检测限为-145.52 dB，强度响应灵敏度比正常外差干扰高10 4 。因此，该系统具有带宽大、灵敏度高、精度高等优点。有望广泛应用于非合作高速运动目标的监测。

data.title: Efficient Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm deep unrolling for phase retrieval with a complex forward path
data.author: Shengyuan Yan, Mike Holenderski, Nirvana Meratnia
data.summary: Phase retrieval problems occur in a wide range of optical systems characterized by different forward path complexities. The Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm deep unrolling technique is a state-of-the-art phase retrieval method. Its inference speed is determined by the complexity of the forward path. We propose FourierGSNet, an efficient Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm deep unrolling method, to achieve faster phase retrieval for applications with high forward path complexities. FourierGSNet does not directly unroll Gerchberg–Saxton iterations with the forward path of the system. Instead, it extracts physics knowledge from unrolled iterations using the Fourier transform as a simplified forward path and injects the knowledge into a cascaded neural network for phase retrieval for the actual system. We evaluated FourierGSNet on three applications with three degrees of complexities: (i) coherent diffractive imaging with Fourier transform as a simple forward path, (ii) near-field X-ray imaging with Fresnel diffraction as a medium-complexity forward path, and (iii) laser beam shaping with the entire simulated optical train as a complex forward path. We compare FourierGSNet with direct unrolling, two fitting methods, and state-of-the-art data-driven methods. Experiments show that FourierGSNet is significantly faster in inference than direct unrolling on high-complexity applications while achieving equal or higher accuracy than compared methods.
data.title_cn: 高效的 Gerchberg-Saxton 算法深度展开，用于具有复杂前向路径的相位检索
data.abstract_cn: 相位恢复问题出现在各种具有不同前向路径复杂性的光学系统中。 Gerchberg-Saxton 算法深度展开技术是一种最先进的相位检索方法。其推理速度由前向路径的复杂性决定。我们提出了 FourierGSNet，这是一种高效的 Gerchberg-Saxton 算法深度展开方法，可以为具有高前向路径复杂性的应用实现更快的相位检索。 FourierGSNet 并不直接用系统的前向路径展开 Gerchberg-Saxton 迭代。相反，它使用傅里叶变换作为简化的前向路径从展开的迭代中提取物理知识，并将知识注入级联神经网络中以用于实际系统的相位检索。我们在三个复杂程度的三个应用上评估了 FourierGSNet：（i）以傅里叶变换作为简单前向路径的相干衍射成像，（ii）以菲涅尔衍射作为中等复杂性前向路径的近场 X 射线成像，以及（iii）以整个模拟光学序列作为复杂前向路径的激光束整形。我们将 FourierGSNet 与直接展开、两种拟合方法和最先进的数据驱动方法进行比较。实验表明，在高复杂性应用中，FourierGSNet 的推理速度明显快于直接展开，同时与比较方法相比，其准确性相同或更高。

data.title: Angular momentum of light
data.author: Antonio Ambrosio, Francois Courvoisier, Marco Ornigotti
data.summary: Over the past few decades, angular momentum of light has attracted increasing interest from many research groups. This comes without surprise, considering the widespread range of applications related to the classical and quantum implications of this property of light in fields such as optical forces and torque, quantum optics, and microscopy. In addition, a large variety of devices and techniques continue to be developed to progress in the manipulation and structuring of angular momentum as a versatile degree of freedom of light. This Special Topic aims at showcasing the latest progress in theory and experiments related to the angular momentum of light.
data.title_cn: 光的角动量
data.abstract_cn: 在过去的几十年里，光的角动量引起了许多研究小组越来越多的兴趣。考虑到光的这种特性的经典和量子含义在光学力和扭矩、量子光学和显微镜等领域的广泛应用，这一点并不令人意外。此外，各种各样的设备和技术不断被开发，以在角动量的操纵和结构化方面取得进展，作为一种多功能的光自由度。本专题旨在展示与光角动量相关的理论和实验的最新进展。

data.title: HiFormer: Hierarchical Transformer with Box-packed Positional Encoding for 3D Part Assembly
data.author: Songle Chen, Lulu Dong, Yijiao Zhou, Siguang Chen, Kai Xu
data.summary: Estimating the 6-DoF posture of parts in assembly-based modeling is a critical task in the fields of computer graphics, computer vision and robotics. A typical scenario involves enabling a machine agent to automatically assemble IKEA furniture using the provided parts. This paper presents HiFormer, a novel Hierarchical Transformer with Box-packed Positional Encoding, designed for highly automatic 3D part assembly. Our method addresses three important issues commonly encountered in 3D part assembly: 1) How to mitigate the overfitting problem associated with Transformer-based feature learning for 3D point clouds? 2) How to effectively model the relationships between the intragroup and intergroup parts? 3) How to compute positional encoding and integrate it into the Transformer for parts with diverse geometric forms in the coarse-to-fine assembly process? These challenges are tackled through three key contributions: 1) a multi-task 3D Swin Transformer with a two-stage training strategy for feature extraction, 2) a novel hierarchical Transformer for capturing part relationships at flattening, intragroup, and intergroup levels, and 3) an innovative box-packed positional encoding that enhances the Transformer by incorporating query, key, and value information derived from relative box positions. On the PartNet benchmark, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art PWH-MP model on three representative categories-Chair, Table, and Lamp-, achieving average improvements of 2.84% in Part Accuracy (PA) and 3.72% in Connection Accuracy (CA) for diversity modeling (with noise), and 3.55% in PA and 3.21% in CA for deterministic modeling (without noise).
data.title_cn: HiFormer：具有盒装位置编码的分层变压器，用于 3D 零件装配
data.abstract_cn: 在基于装配的建模中估计零件的 6-DoF 姿态是计算机图形、计算机视觉和机器人领域的一项关键任务。一个典型的场景是让机器代理使用提供的零件自动组装宜家家具。本文介绍了 HiFormer，一种具有盒装位置编码的新型分层变压器，专为高度自动化的 3D 零件装配而设计。我们的方法解决了 3D 零件装配中常见的三个重要问题：1）如何缓解与基于 Transformer 的 3D 点云特征学习相关的过度拟合问题？ 2）如何有效地建模组内和组间部分之间的关​​系？ 3）对于从粗到精的装配过程中具有不同几何形状的零件，如何计算位置编码并将其集成到Transformer中？这些挑战是通过三个关键贡献来解决的：1) 具有两阶段特征提取训练策略的多任务 3D Swin Transformer，2) 一种新颖的分层 Transformer，用于捕获扁平化、组内和组间级别的零件关系，3) 一种创新的盒装位置编码，通过合并从相对盒位置导出的查询、键和值信息来增强 Transformer。在 PartNet 基准上，我们的方法在三个代表性类别（椅子、桌子和灯）上优于最先进的 PWH-MP 模型，多样性建模（有噪声）的零件精度（PA）平均提高了 2.84%，连接精度（CA）平均提高了 3.72%，确定性建模（无噪声）的 PA 平均提高了 3.55%，CA 平均提高了 3.21%。

data.title: Contextualization or Rationalization? The Effect of Causal Priors on Data Visualization Interpretation
data.author: Arran Zeyu Wang, David Borland, Estella Calcaterra, David Gotz
data.summary: Understanding how individuals interpret charts is a crucial concern for visual data communication. This imperative has motivated a number of studies, including past work demonstrating that causal priors–a priori belief about causal relationships between concepts–can have significant influences on the perceived strength of variable relationships inferred from visualizations. This paper builds on these previous results, demonstrating that causal priors can also influence the types of patterns that people perceive as the most salient within ambiguous scatterplots that have roughly equal evidence for trend and cluster patterns. Using a mixed-design approach that combines a largescale online experiment for breadth of findings with an in-person think-aloud study for analytical depth, we investigated how users' interpretations are influenced by the interplay between causal priors and the visualized data patterns. Our analysis suggests two archetypal reasoning behaviors through which people often make their observations: contextualization, in which users accept a visual pattern that aligns with causal priors and use their existing knowledge to enrich interpretation, and rationalization, in which users encounter a pattern that conflicts with causal priors and attempt to explain away the discrepancy by invoking external factors, such as positing confounding variables or data selection bias. These findings provide initial evidence highlighting the critical role of causal priors in shaping high-level visualization comprehension, and introduce a vocabulary for describing how users reason about data that either confirms or challenges prior beliefs of causality.
data.title_cn: 情境化还是合理化？因果先验对数据可视化解释的影响
data.abstract_cn: 了解个人如何解释图表是视觉数据通信的一个关键问题。这一必要性激发了许多研究，包括过去的工作证明因果先验（关于概念之间因果关系的先验信念）可以对从可视化推断出的变量关系的感知强度产生重大影响。本文建立在这些先前结果的基础上，证明因果先验也可以影响人们在模糊散点图中视为最显着的模式类型，这些散点图具有大致相同的趋势和集群模式证据。我们采用混合设计方法，将大规模在线实验与深入分析的现场发声思考研究相结合，研究了因果先验与可视化数据模式之间的相互作用如何影响用户的解释。我们的分析提出了人们经常进行观察的两种典型推理行为：情境化，其中用户接受与因果先验一致的视觉模式，并利用他们现有的知识来丰富解释；以及合理化，其中用户遇到与因果先验相冲突的模式，并试图通过调用外部因素（例如设置混杂变量或数据选择偏差）来解释差异。这些发现提供了初步证据，强调了因果先验在塑造高水平可视化理解方面的关键作用，并引入了一个词汇表来描述用户如何推理确认或挑战因果关系先验信念的数据。

data.title: AnchorCrafter: Animate Cyber-Anchors Selling Your Products via Human-Object Interacting Video Generation
data.author: Ziyi Xu, Ziyao Huang, Juan Cao, Yong Zhang, Xiaodong Cun, Qing Shuai, Yuchen Wang, Linchao Bao, Fan Tang
data.summary: The generation of anchor-style product promotion videos presents promising opportunities in e-commerce, advertising, and consumer engagement. Despite advancements in pose-guided human video generation, creating product promotion videos remains challenging. In addressing this challenge, we identify the integration of human-object interactions (HOI) into pose-guided human video generation as a core issue. To this end, we introduce AnchorCrafter, a novel diffusion-based system designed to generate 2D videos featuring a target human and a customized object, achieving high visual fidelity and controllable interactions. Specifically, we propose two key innovations: the HOI-appearance perception, which enhances object appearance recognition from arbitrary multi-view perspectives and disentangles object and human appearance, and the HOI-motion injection, which enables complex human-object interactions by overcoming challenges in object trajectory conditioning and inter-occlusion management. Extensive experiments show that our system improves object appearance preservation by 7.5%, and achieves the best video quality compared to existing state-of-the-art approaches. It also outperforms existing approaches in maintaining human motion consistency and high-quality video generation. Project page including data, code, and Huggingface demo: https://github.com/cangcz/AnchorCrafter .
data.title_cn: AnchorCrafter：动画网络主播通过人机交互视频生成来销售您的产品
data.abstract_cn: 主播式产品宣传视频的产生为电子商务、广告和消费者参与提供了广阔的机遇。尽管姿势引导的人类视频生成取得了进步，但创建产品宣传视频仍然具有挑战性。在应对这一挑战时，我们将人与物体交互（HOI）集成到姿势引导的人类视频生成中作为核心问题。为此，我们推出了 AnchorCrafter，这是一种新颖的基于扩散的系统，旨在生成以目标人和定制对象为特征的 2D 视频，实现高视觉保真度和可控交互。具体来说，我们提出了两项​​关键创新：HOI-外观感知，它增强了从任意多视角的物体外观识别，并解开了物体和人类外观的关系；HOI-运动注入，它通过克服物体轨迹调节和相互遮挡管理方面的挑战，实现复杂的人与物体交互。大量实验表明，与现有最先进的方法相比，我们的系统将对象外观保留提高了 7.5%，并实现了最佳视频质量。它在保持人体运动一致性和高质量视频生成方面也优于现有方法。项目页面包括数据、代码和 Huggingface 演示：https://github.com/cangcz/AnchorCrafter 。

data.title: Multi-Resolution Alignment for Voxel Sparsity in Camera-Based 3D Semantic Scene Completion
data.author: Zhiwen Yang, Yuxin Peng
data.summary: Camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) offers a cost-effective solution for assessing the geometric occupancy and semantic labels of each voxel in the surrounding 3D scene with image inputs, providing a voxel-level scene perception foundation for the perception-prediction-planning autonomous driving systems. Although significant progress has been made in existing methods, their optimization rely solely on the supervision from voxel labels and face the challenge of voxel sparsity as a large portion of voxels in autonomous driving scenarios are empty, which limits both optimization efficiency and model performance. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Resolution Alignment (MRA) approach to mitigate voxel sparsity in camera-based 3D semantic scene completion, which exploits the scene and instance level alignment across multi-resolution 3D features as auxiliary supervision. Specifically, we first propose the Multi-resolution View Transformer module, which projects 2D image features into multi-resolution 3D features and aligns them at the scene level through fusing discriminative seed features. Furthermore, we design the Cubic Semantic Anisotropy module to identify the instance-level semantic significance of each voxel, accounting for the semantic differences of a specific voxel against its neighboring voxels within a cubic area. Finally, we devise a Critical Distribution Alignment module, which selects critical voxels as instance-level anchors with the guidance of cubic semantic anisotropy, and applies a circulated loss for auxiliary supervision on the critical feature distribution consistency across different resolutions. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 datasets demonstrate that our MRA approach significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, showcasing its effectiveness in mitigating the impact of sparse voxel labels. The code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/MRA_TIP.
data.title_cn: 基于相机的 3D 语义场景补全中体素稀疏性的多分辨率对齐
data.abstract_cn: 基于摄像头的 3D 语义场景完成 (SSC) 提供了一种经济高效的解决方案，用于通过图像输入评估周围 3D 场景中每个体素的几何占用和语义标签，为感知预测规划自动驾驶系统提供体素级场景感知基础。尽管现有方法取得了重大进展，但其优化仅依赖于体素标签的监督，并且由于自动驾驶场景中大部分体素是空的，因此面临体素稀疏性的挑战，这限制了优化效率和模型性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种多分辨率对齐（MRA）方法来减轻基于相机的 3D 语义场景完成中的体素稀疏性，该方法利用跨多分辨率 3D 特征的场景和实例级对齐作为辅助监督。具体来说，我们首先提出了多分辨率视图变换器模块，它将 2D 图像特征投影为多分辨率 3D 特征，并通过融合判别性种子特征在场景级别将它们对齐。此外，我们设计了立方语义各向异性模块来识别每个体素的实例级语义重要性，解释立方区域内特定体素与其相邻体素的语义差异。最后，我们设计了一个关键分布对齐模块，该模块在立方语义各向异性的指导下选择关键体素作为实例级锚点，并应用循环损失来辅助监督不同分辨率下关键特征分布的一致性。对 SemanticKITTI 和 SSCBench-KITTI-360 数据集的大量实验表明，我们的 MRA 方法显着优于现有的最先进方法，展示了其在减轻稀疏体素标签影响方面的有效性。该代码可从 https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/MRA_TIP 获取。

data.title: Learning Retinex Prior for Compressive Hyperspectral Image Reconstruction
data.author: Mengzu Liu, Junwei Xu, Weisheng Dong, Le Dong, Guangming Shi
data.summary: Image reconstruction in coded aperture snapshot spectral compressive imaging (CASSI) aims to recover high-fidelity hyperspectral images (HSIs) from compressed 2D measurements. While deep unfolding networks have shown promising performance, the degradation induced by the CASSI degradation model often introduces global illumination discrepancies in the reconstructions, creating artifacts similar to those in low-light images. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Retinex Prior-Driven Unfolding Network (RPDUN), which unfolds the optimization incorporating the Retinex prior as a regularization term into a multi-stage network. This design provides global illumination adjustment for compressed measurements, effectively compensating for spatial-spectral degradation according to physical modulation and capturing intrinsic spectral characteristics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of the Retinex prior in hyperspectral image reconstruction. Furthermore, to mitigate the noise in the reflectance domain, which can be amplified during decomposition, we introduce an Adaptive Token Selection Transformer (ATST). This module adaptively filters out weakly correlated tokens before the self-attention computation, effectively reducing noise and artifacts within the recovered reflectance map. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that RPDUN achieves new state-of-the-art performance, significantly improving reconstruction quality while maintaining computational efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/ZUGE0312/RPDUN.
data.title_cn: 学习 Retinex Prior 用于压缩高光谱图像重建
data.abstract_cn: 编码孔径快照光谱压缩成像 (CASSI) 中的图像重建旨在从压缩的二维测量中恢复高保真高光谱图像 (HSI)。虽然深度展开网络已显示出良好的性能，但 CASSI 退化模型引起的退化通常会在重建中引入全局照明差异，从而产生与低光图像中类似的伪影。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的 Retinex 先验驱动展开网络（RPDUN），它将 Retinex 先验作为正则化项合并到多级网络中进行优化。该设计为压缩测量提供全局照明调整，根据物理调制有效补偿空间光谱退化并捕获固有光谱特性。据我们所知，这是 Retinex 先验在高光谱图像重建中的首次应用。此外，为了减轻反射域中的噪声（这些噪声在分解过程中可能会被放大），我们引入了自适应令牌选择变压器（ATST）。该模块在自注意力计算之前自适应地过滤掉弱相关标记，有效减少恢复的反射率图中的噪声和伪影。对模拟和真实数据集的大量实验表明，RPDUN 实现了新的最先进的性能，显着提高了重建质量，同时保持了计算效率。代码可在 https://github.com/ZUGE0312/RPDUN 获取。

data.title: FreeStyle: Towards Style-Inclusive Sketch-based Person Retrieval
data.author: Xinyi Wu, Cuiqun Chen, Hui Zeng, Zhiping Cai, Mang Ye
data.summary: Sketch-based Person Retrieval (SBPR) aims to identify and retrieve a target individual across non-overlapping camera views using professional sketches as queries. In practice, sketches drawn by different artists often present diverse painting styles unpredictably. The substantial style variations among sketches pose significant challenges to the stability and generalizability of SBPR models. Prior works attempt to mitigate style variations through style manipulation methods, which inevitably undermine the inherent structural relations among multiple sketch features. This leads to overfitting on existing training styles and struggles with generalizing to new, unseen sketch styles. In this paper, we introduce FreeStyle, an innovative style-inclusive framework for SBPR, built upon the foundational CLIP architecture. FreeStyle explicitly models the relations across diverse sketch styles via style consistency enhancement, enabling dynamic adaptation to both seen and unseen style variations. Specifically, Diverse Style Semantic Unification is first devised to enhance the style consistency of each identity at the semantic level by introducing objective attribute-level semantic constraints. Meanwhile, Diverse Style Feature Squeezing tackles unclear feature boundaries among identities by concentrating the intra-identity space and separating the inter-identity space, thereby strengthening style consistency at the feature representation level. Additionally, considering the feature distribution discrepancy between sketches and photos, an identity-centric cross-modal prototype alignment mechanism is introduced to facilitate identity-aware cross-modal associations and promote a compact joint embedding space. Extensive experiments validate that FreeStyle not only achieves stable performance under seen style variations but also demonstrates strong generalization to unseen sketch styles.
data.title_cn: FreeStyle：走向风格包容的基于草图的人物检索
data.abstract_cn: 基于草图的人物检索（SBPR）旨在使用专业草图作为查询，在不重叠的摄像机视图中识别和检索目标个体。在实践中，不同艺术家绘制的素描往往呈现出难以预料的多样绘画风格。草图之间巨大的风格差异对 SBPR 模型的稳定性和通用性提出了重大挑战。先前的作品试图通过风格操纵方法来减轻风格变化，这不可避免地破坏了多个草图特征之间的固有结构关系。这会导致对现有训练风格的过度拟合，并且很难推广到新的、看不见的草图风格。在本文中，我们介绍了 FreeStyle，这是一种基于 CLIP 基础架构的创新型包含样式的 SBPR 框架。 FreeStyle 通过风格一致性增强显式地模拟不同草图风格之间的关系，从而能够动态适应可见和不可见的风格变化。具体来说，多样化风格语义统一首先通过引入客观属性级语义约束来增强每个身份在语义层面的风格一致性。同时，多样化风格特征压缩通过集中身份内空间和分离身份间空间来解决身份之间特征边界不清晰的问题，从而增强特征表示层面的风格一致性。此外，考虑到草图和照片之间的特征分布差异，引入了以身份为中心的跨模态原型对齐机制，以促进身份感知的跨模态关联并促进紧凑的联合嵌入空间。大量的实验验证了 FreeStyle 不仅在可见的样式变化下实现了稳定的性能，而且还展示了对未见的草图样式的强大泛化能力。

data.title: Calibrating Biased Distribution in VFM-derived Latent Space via Cross-Domain Geometric Consistency
data.author: Yanbiao Ma, Wei Dai, Zhiwu Lu, Bowei Liu, Jiayi Chen, Wenke Huang, Junchi Yan, Guancheng Wan
data.summary: Despite the fast progress of deep learning, one standing challenge is the gap of the observed training samples and the underlying true distribution. There are multiple reasons for the causing of this gap e.g., sampling bias, noise etc. In the era of foundation models, we show that when leveraging the off-the-shelf (vision) foundation models (e.g., CLIP, DINOv2) for feature extraction, the geometric shapes of the resulting feature distributions exhibit remarkable transferability across domains and datasets. To verify its practical usefulness, we embody our geometric knowledge-guided distribution calibration framework in two popular and challenging settings: federated learning and long-tailed recognition. In the federated setting, we devise a technique of acquiring the global geometric shape under privacy constraints, then leverage this knowledge to generate new samples for clients, in the aim of bridging the gap between local and global observations. In long-tailed learning, it utilizes the geometric knowledge transferred from sample-rich categories to recover the true distribution for sample-scarce tail classes. Comprehensive experiments show that our proposed geometric knowledge-guided distribution calibration effectively overcomes information deficits caused by data heterogeneity and sample imbalance, with boosted performance across benchmarks. Code published at: https://github.com/WeiDai-David/2025CVPR GGEUR.
data.journal: IEEE Trans. Pattern Anal. Mach. Intell.
data.title_cn: 通过跨域几何一致性校准 VFM 导出的潜在空间中的偏差分布
data.abstract_cn: 尽管深度学习进展迅速，但一个长期存在的挑战是观察到的训练样本与潜在真实分布之间的差距。造成这种差距的原因有多种，例如采样偏差、噪声等。在基础模型时代，我们表明，当利用现成的（视觉）基础模型（例如 CLIP、DINOv2）进行特征提取时，所得特征分布的几何形状表现出跨领域和数据集的显着可迁移性。为了验证其实用性，我们将几何知识引导的分布校准框架体现在两种流行且具有挑战性的环境中：联邦学习和长尾识别。在联合环境中，我们设计了一种在隐私约束下获取全局几何形状的技术，然后利用这些知识为客户生成新样本，以弥合本地观察和全局观察之间的差距。在长尾学习中，它利用从样本丰富的类别转移的几何知识来恢复样本稀缺的尾类的真实分布。综合实验表明，我们提出的几何知识引导的分布校准有效克服了数据异质性和样本不平衡造成的信息缺陷，并提高了基准测试的性能。代码发布于：https://github.com/WeiDai-David/2025CVPR GGEUR。

data.title: Hierarchical Information Embeddings with Neural ODEs for Personalized Federated Learning
data.author: Rui She, Sijie Wang, Qiyu Kang, Kai Zhao, Tianyu Geng, Yanan Zhao, Wenfei Liang, Wee Peng Tay
data.summary: Personalized federated learning (PFL) plays a pivotal role in ensuring efficient privacy preservation and secure collaborative learning. However, PFL faces significant challenges due to data heterogeneity and device diversity. To enhance personalization and robustness in PFL, we propose a novel model called FedNODE , which leverages hierarchical embeddings. FedNODE incorporates personalized , pseudo-generic , and fusion embeddings to facilitate hierarchical information representation. We utilize a hypernetwork based on neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) within the server to generate backbone parameters for different clients, enabling the creation of personalized embeddings. Additionally, we introduce a pseudo-generic embedding based on a learnable vector to balance personalized and generic information. A neural ODE-based network follows the backbone module for each client, integrating personalized and pseudo-generic embeddings. To validate the efficacy of FedNODE, we conduct extensive evaluations across various classification datasets, encompassing diverse statistically heterogeneous settings and noisy scenarios. The results demonstrate that FedNODE achieves state-of-the-art performance.

data.title_cn: 用于个性化联合学习的神经常微分方程的分层信息嵌入
data.abstract_cn: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）在确保有效的隐私保护和安全的协作学习方面发挥着关键作用。然而，由于数据异构性和设备多样性，PFL 面临着重大挑战。为了增强 PFL 的个性化和稳健性，我们提出了一种名为 FedNODE 的新颖模型，它利用分层嵌入。 FedNODE 结合了个性化、伪通用和融合嵌入来促进分层信息表示。我们在服务器内利用基于神经常微分方程（ODE）的超网络为不同客户端生成主干参数，从而能够创建个性化嵌入。此外，我们引入了基于可学习向量的伪通用嵌入来平衡个性化和通用信息。基于 ODE 的神经网络遵循每个客户端的主干模块，集成个性化和伪通用嵌入。为了验证 FedNODE 的有效性，我们对各种分类数据集进行了广泛的评估，包括不同的统计异构设置和噪声场景。结果表明 FedNODE 实现了最先进的性能。
